summary: SMIC Q3 2026 revenue hit $3.19B, beating estimates by 2.57%; EPS of $0.05 missed forecasts by 2.53% amid strong AI chip demand.
Gross margin surged to 29.9%, well above 26-28% guidance, driven by 97.3% capacity utilization and improved product mix.
Q4 revenue guidance projects 4-6% sequential growth to $3.32-3.38B; full-year 2026 revenue expected to exceed $12B, up 30% YoY.
CEO Zhao cited supply-constrained AI demand continuing through 2027, though consumer electronics and smartphone segments remain weak.
Equipment supply constraints and rising depreciation pose risks; shares flat at $48.74, down 47.6% from 52-week high of $93.
